about: Stream-safe mode's built-in playlists (docs/hails-additions/46-stream-safe-music.md). Only tracks whose license the artist or label states on their own page: CC0 or CC BY (also CC BY-NC / BY-SA / BY-NC-SA: the engine is always free to use) from Free Music Archive, Internet Archive (artist / netlabel uploads only; uploader-set licenses there are often wrong) and OpenGameArt. Every track is credited in full, even under CC0. A file local-playlists.json in the launcher's stream-safe folder adds playlists for local use.
